title: Jeroboam’s Border and Azariah’s Reign
reflectionText: Israel has no helper, yet Yahweh sees its bitter affliction and saves it through a king whose evil is plainly named. Azariah’s reign also holds both commendation and limits. What do you notice when these judgments and acts of mercy remain together in the record of the kings?
